exploit_name: Malicious user can prevent buying back OLAS token via Slipstream
description: The buyback operation on Slipstream lacks strict slippage protection, allowing attackers to sandwich the transaction.
root_cause: The buyback operation on Slipstream lacks strict slippage protection, allowing attackers to sandwich the transaction.
fix_description: Enforce strict slippage limits. Use TWAP-based pricing from a reliable oracle.
notes: Buyback operations can fail or execute at poor prices, reducing OLAS burning efficiency.
